title: Choose Fit's new visual world
question: A full redesign of Home, Result, Me and Together. The roll assigned The Guest Check. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Guest Check
options.lineage: the diner server's pale-green guest check pad, carbon copy and tear-off stub
options.thesis: Every scan reads like an order written up at your table: one ruled line per dish, and a tear-off stub of questions to show your server.
options.viewport: Home leads with one big 'Scan a menu' action on a guest-check green field, check-numbered recent scans ruled beneath it, and the profile reduced to one line: 'Checking 12 rules for you'.
options.risk: Without care the ruled lines read as nostalgia; the rules must stay hairline and the shell native iOS (tabs, sheets, buttons).

raised.raise: Verdicts are carried by line form as well as colour: a ruled line under a Good fit, a dashed line under Can't tell, the dish name carbon-struck for Not a fit.
One area dominates each screen: on Home it is the scan action, on Result the list, never a dashboard of numbers.
One type size does most of the work; hierarchy comes from weight and the ruled column, cutting today's seven sizes to four.
Destructive actions (remove a rule, sign out) sit apart, in outline, never beside the primary.

options.label: The Pharmacy Label
options.lineage: prescription bottle labels and their coloured auxiliary warning stickers
options.thesis: Your rules are printed like a prescription label, and each finding sticks onto a dish as a small auxiliary sticker: 'Ask: made with butter?'.
options.viewport: Home is a label for you: name line, 'Checks 12 rules', a sources line, and a big scan button; result dishes carry finding stickers.
options.risk: Familiar and strongly clinical; sticker colours fight the four verdict colours unless stickers stay single-ink.

options.label: The Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets and carbon coupons
options.thesis: Each scan is a coupon in a wallet; verdicts stamp onto dishes and nothing disappears, it cancels.
options.viewport: Home is a wallet of scan coupons with the newest on top and the scan action as the wallet's clasp.
options.case: Stamped states map cleanly onto the verdicts (clarity holds), but travel ephemera says little to someone managing their health.
options.risk: Its red VOID stamp collides with Not a fit; travel nostalgia can read as a theme.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.lineage: glass spectrograms on a viewing box
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one off-centre rail; state is line form, not hue.
options.viewport: Destinations as ticks on a rail; the open one blooms into a plate.
options.case: Loses both axes: abstract and dark, foreign to a dinner table.
options.risk: Unreadable in a dim restaurant to a non-technical user.
options.kept: State carried by line form (solid, dashed, struck), so verdicts never rely on colour.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.lineage: summer zoo and garden guide maps
options.thesis: Every area a swelling lobe of flat colour; one lobe dominates each screen.
options.viewport: One green lobe swelling across the screen with a GATE capsule.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful map language overwhelms verdict colour.
options.risk: Its colours would drown the four verdict colours.

options.label: Acetate Tab Manual
options.thesis: Acetate leaves over full-hue divider boards; one type size does the work.
options.viewport: A tabbed manual open at a section.
options.case: Loses both axes: reference-manual reading at a dinner table.
options.risk: Slow, bookish browsing for a seconds-long task.
options.kept: One type size doing most of the work.

options.label: Developer Console
options.thesis: Graphite panels with hairline seams; destructive actions isolated.
options.case: Loses both axes: a developer's world, not a diner's.
options.risk: Cold and technical for health anxiety.
options.kept: Destructive actions set apart from everything else.

options.label: Streaming Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles; the focused one grows and the rest dims.
options.case: Loses both axes: browsing entertainment, not choosing food safely.
options.kept: Focus dims what you are not deciding about (already in the menu overlay).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What food-scanner apps ship (Yuka, Cal AI): white cards, a big score, green-to-red badges, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design, and close to what is confusing today.
